description: This is an ASP.NET web form code-behind file for the AdminPanel page in the Online Examination System. It contains event handlers for various button clicks that navigate to different pages.

classes.name: AdminPanel
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminPanel ASP.NET page, handling user interactions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for page load event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for home button click; currently does nothing.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to AdminQueue.aspx when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to AdminLeaderboard.aspx when the leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: sExamB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to SetExam.aspx for setting up exams.

methods.name: eExamB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to EditExam.aspx for editing exams.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to LoginPage.aspx to log out.
